text: Pencil is to sketching as knife is to:
explanation: A pencil is used for sketching, just as a knife is used for cutting.

text: Teacher is to instructing as chef is to:
explanation: A teacher instructs, a chef cooks.

text: Identify assumption: To pass the exam, students must review notes.
optionB: Not reviewing notes leads to failure
explanation: The statement assumes that without reviewing notes, passing is unlikely.

optionB: Not thinking logically leads to failure

X is Y's brother, Y is Z's sister, and Z is a boy. Z is X's:
explanation: X (male), Y (female), Z (male), so Z is X's brother.

text: J is K's brother, K is L's sister, and L is a girl. L is J's:
explanation: J is the brother, K and L are his sisters, so L is J’s sister.

text: If P is Q’s father, Q is R’s daughter, R is P’s:
explanation: P is the father, Q is his daughter, so R must be P’s wife (Q’s mother).

text: All roses are red. Some flowers are roses. So some flowers are red.
explanation: Since all roses are red and some flowers are roses, those flowers must be red.

text: All dancers perform. Some people are dancers. So some people perform.
explanation: Since all dancers perform and some people are dancers, those people perform.

text: If it is rainy tomorrow, I will not visit my friend’s house. If I will visit my friend’s house, then ___________________
explanation: Contrapositive: If I visit, then not rainy.

text: If all Bloops are Razzies and some Razzies are Lalas, then:
explanation: The statement doesn't specify if the Lalas overlap with Bloops, so it cannot be determined.

text: If all stars shine and some celestial bodies are stars, then:
explanation: Some celestial bodies (stars) must shine.

text: If all chairs have legs and some furniture are chairs, then:
explanation: Some furniture (chairs) must have legs.

text: All teachers educate. Some professionals are teachers. So some professionals educate.
explanation: Since all teachers educate and some professionals are teachers, those professionals educate.

text: If all rivers flow and some waterways are rivers, then:
explanation: Some waterways (rivers) must flow.

text: Only confident people are actors. All actors are wealthy. Ben is wealthy. Is 'Ben is a confident person' undoubtedly true?
explanation: Wealthy does not necessarily mean actor, so not necessarily confident.

text: All birds fly. Penguins do not fly. So penguins are not birds.
explanation: Valid deduction from the premise.

text: All architects design. Some professionals are architects. So some professionals design.
explanation: Since all architects design and some professionals are architects, those professionals design.

text: All pilots fly. Some people are pilots. So some people fly.
explanation: Since all pilots fly and some people are pilots, those people fly.

text: Odd one out: Fork, Spoon, Knife, Plate
explanation: Plate is used for serving, while the others are utensils for eating.

text: Odd one out: Guitar, Violin, Piano, Flute
explanation: Piano is a keyboard instrument, while the others are string or wind instruments.

text: Odd one out: Rose, Tulip, Daisy, Oak
explanation: Oak is a tree, while the others are flowers.

text: Odd one out: Pen, Pencil, Marker, Eraser
explanation: Eraser removes marks, while the others create marks.

text: Odd one out: Book, Magazine, Newspaper, Pen
explanation: Pen is a writing tool, while the others are reading materials.

text: Odd one out: Dog, Cat, Horse, Bird
explanation: Bird is not a mammal, while the others are.

text: Which is odd one out: Apple, Banana, Carrot, Orange
explanation: Carrot is a vegetable, while the others are fruits.

text: Next in series: 10, 17, 25, 34, ____
explanation: The differences are 7, 8, 9, so the next is 10: 34 + 10 = 44.
steps:
1. The gaps are 7, 8, 9 — they grow by 1 each time, so the next gap is 10.
2. Next: 44.
hint: Write the difference between neighbours. If that isn't constant, try ratios or the differences of differences.
stepsTl:
1. Tingnan ang pagitan: 7, 8, 9. Lumalaki ng 1.
2. Kaya ang susunod ay 44.
hintTl: Isulat ang pagitan ng bawat numero. Kung hindi pare-pareho, subukan ang ratio.

text: Next in series: 3, 7, 12, 18, ____
explanation: The differences are 4, 5, 6, so the next is 7: 18 + 7 = 26.

text: Next in series: 6, 13, 21, 30, ____
explanation: The differences are 7, 8, 9, so the next is 10: 30 + 10 = 40.
